x33 = argmax(x30, x32): over the palette colors, find color c maximizing x32(c). x32(c) = x31(x29(c)) = (x29(c) == dmirror(x29(c))). Boolean. argmax picks the color where this is True. Then x34 = x29(x33).

Then x29 = compose(x25, x28): x29(target) = x25(x28(target)). x25 = chain(first, x24, initset) where x24 = rbind(rapply, I) = lambda functions: rapply(functions, I). rapply(functions, value) = apply each function to value -> tuple. x27(target) = compose(x19(target), x17(target)). x17 = chain(x15, x16, x5): x17(target) = x15(x16(x5(target))). x16 = lbind(compose, x7) = lambda f: compose(x7, f) = lambda f: lambda y: x7(f(y)). So x16(x5(target)) = compose(x7, x5(target)) = lambda grid: x7(x5(target)(grid)).

x7 = compose(x6, dmirror) = lambda p: x6(dmirror(p)) = dmirror(p) shifted by ORIGIN (no shift). So x7 = dmirror (transpose).

x15 = lbind(x14, identity) where x14 = lbind(fork, paint). fork(paint, a, b) = lambda x: paint(a(x), b(x)). lbind(x14, identity) = lbind(lbind(fork,paint), identity): fixes leftmost arg of fork to paint -> gives f = lambda a, b: fork(paint, a, b).
